title: Real-Time Estimation of Pitch and Tilt Angles of Active-Axis Wind Turbine Using BNO085 Inertial Measurement Unit
content: The active-axis wind turbine (AAWT) is a novel turbine design with a single blade that rotates around an axis that is neither horizontal nor vertical, but can be actively tilted by changing the blade pitch. The pitch and tilt angles of the AAWT rotor are key to controlling the centrifugal and aerodynamic forces acting on the rotor and, in turn, system stability. However, they are difficult to monitor in practice. This study presents a method to estimate these angles and provide feedback for blade pitch actuation and turbine rotor control. The proposed framework estimates these angles using two BNO085 inertial measurement units (IMUs): one mounted on the blade and one mounted on the rotor cross-arm. The differential angular velocity from the corresponding gyroscopes is integrated to distinguish blade pitch from the underlying yaw motion (rotation) of the rotor. Also, rotor tilt is estimated by decoupling rotor tilting and yaw motion from the cross-arm IMU using quaternion orientation. The effect of yaw motion (rotation) is removed using a quaternion conjugate to extract the tilt angle. The developed method is therefore well suited to estimating the AAWT rotor orientation and providing feedback to control its pitch and tilt angles. This is a significant advance in developing a control system for the novel AAWT.
